title: Left exact conormal sequence for coefficient reduction to a projective symmetric algebra
statement: Let P be a commutative ring, I an ideal, A=P/I, and M=I/I² projective over A. Let q:A^m→M be surjective, C=Sym_A(M) [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property], α:A[y]→C the canonical surjective presentation, and φ:P[y]→C its composite with coefficient reduction. Put J=ker φ and L=ker α. There are C-linear maps i:C⊗_A M→J/J² and r:J/J²→L/L², with i injective, r surjective and image(i)=ker(r). Their formulas are i(c⊗[x])=c[C(x)] and r([z])=[z mod I]. No splitting or conormal identification of L/L² is asserted.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07CE (lemma-improve-presentation), lines 357-414, especially equation-sequence and its splitting in lines 369-414. The projective case repairs the use of More on Algebra Lemma Tag 07EV: its general claim K tensor C = J/J^2 is false, as recorded in lem-weil-pbc-cotangent-complex-symmetric-algebra. Here q splits, so locally M and K are free, the linear relations corresponding to a basis of K are coordinate variables, and the conormal sequence is exact on the left. Algebra Lemma Tag 00S2 supplies the right-exact sequence.

proof.text: Construct the hom of integer-algebra extensions associated to π: Q → A[y]. Compatibility gives comap(ker α) = ker φ and H ≤ J. Apply Mathlib Extension.Cotangent.map to construct r, Extension.Cotangent.map_mk to prove the representative formula, and Extension.Cotangent.map_surjective_of_comap_eq to prove surjectivity. This is the explicit Lean construction in the item.

Use the polynomial coefficient conormal inclusion theorem to obtain i, its representative formula, its image as the classes of H in J/J², and its injectivity criterion. The projective symmetric coefficient intersection identity supplies H ∩ J² = HJ, so i is injective.

Apply Mathlib Extension.Cotangent.map_ker_of_surjective to r. Since H ≤ J, replace H ∩ J with H. Its resulting kernel submodule is exactly the image submodule given by the inclusion theorem. Equality after restriction to Q gives equality of the underlying membership predicates, hence Function.Exact i r. Bundle this with both formulas, injectivity and surjectivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00S2 conormal row, combined with the projective symmetric specialization of More on Algebra Tags 07CX and 07D4 used in smoothing.tex Tag 07CE; reduction and kernel computation implemented with Mathlib Extension.Cotangent.map

lean.statement: theorem projective_symmetric_conormal_reduction_exact (P : Type u) [CommRing P] (I : Ideal P) (m : ℕ) [Module.Projective (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent] (q : (Fin m → P ⧸ I) →ₗ[P ⧸ I] I.Cotangent) (hq : Function.Surjective q) (α : MvPolynomial (Fin m) (P ⧸ I) →ₐ[P ⧸ I] SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (hαX : ∀ j, α (MvPolynomial.X j) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent (q (Pi.single j 1))) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin m) P →+* SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (hφeq : φ = α.toRingHom.comp (MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hα : Function.Surjective α) : ∃ (i : SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent ⊗[P ⧸ I] I.Cotangent →ₗ[SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent] (Extension.ofSurjective φ.toIntAlgHom hφ).Cotangent) (r : (Extension.ofSurjective φ.toIntAlgHom hφ).Cotangent →ₗ[SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent] (Extension.ofSurjective α hα).Cotangent), (∀ (c : SymmetricAlgebra (P ⧸ I) I.Cotangent) (x : I) (y : (Extension.ofSurjective φ.toIntAlgHom hφ).ker), y.1 = MvPolynomial.C x.1 → i (c ⊗ₜ I.toCotangent x) = c • Extension.Cotangent.mk y) ∧ (∀ (x : (Extension.ofSurjective φ.toIntAlgHom hφ).ker) (y : (Extension.ofSurjective α hα).ker), y.1 = MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) x.1 → r (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) = Extension.Cotangent.mk y) ∧ Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i r ∧ Function.Surjective r
